Only half of this is done: WP-21 is now `in-progress` and committed, but I left WP-12 untouched.

The `AGENTS.md` in `../shared_compnents` says: "OrthoQM rows are owned by the OrthoQM team. 3DQM sessions edit only rows marked `3DQM`." WP-12 is an OrthoQM row (currently `review`), so setting it to `done` from this session would break that rule.

The WP-21 commit is `b1062df` on a new branch, `backlog/wp-21-in-progress`, not on `master`. I branched because the repo was on its default branch; it has no remote, so nothing was pushed.

If you have the authority to override the ownership rule, say so and I'll set WP-12 to `done` in a second commit. Otherwise the OrthoQM team needs to make that change. Also tell me if you want the branch merged into `master`.
